summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: repair autonomous publication standards and Planfile dependencies. Return native allocation identities as machine-readable results and reconcile stale host publication instructions without bypassing protected validation.

delivery.outcome: Allocator emits explicit ticket/branch/worktree/lease result; host publication policy updater preserves unrelated instructions and replaces obsolete review-bypass guidance under an expected content digest. Independently published material, tests and scoped host readback.
nonGoals: No product policy or CI check retirement
No foreign change takeover or lease grant from allocator
No direct merge or credential use in updater

architecture.decision: Add an additive JSON result to the successful native allocator; supply a deterministic read-only-by-default host instructions renderer with digest-bound apply, lossless backup and concurrent-writer refusal. Preserve installed governance and unrelated host sections.
interfaceChanges: Host projection query and digest-bound apply CLI
architecture.rollback: Restore exact prior host bytes from saved content-addressed backup; revert source only through protected delivery.

validation.evidence: Canonical and refusal result regression including preserved dirty primary.
Idempotence, preservation, stale-digest, symlink and concurrent-lock tests; exact host projection readback after publication.
Full native suite, OneDev and protected exact-head independent merge.
